assets.name: reedwater
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless overhead ground texture for an original isometric tactical RPG tile set. Primary request: a single square flat repeatable material swatch of muted riverbank grass and compact ochre earth. Style: crisp handcrafted pixel clusters, classic tactical RPG readability, broad calm color masses, restrained texture, green moss and sparse tiny grass tufts over brown soil. Perfectly overhead orthographic, absolutely no perspective or 3D block, no edge border, no elevation or cliff, no scene, no characters, no objects, no rocks larger than a pebble, no buildings, no horizon, no grid, no text. Even diffuse lighting so it repeats cleanly across a map. Fill the square edge to edge. Low contrast enough that small character sprites remain clear. Palette muted moss green, olive, wet ochre soil, dark green flecks. The texture is the top surface material only; geometry will be drawn separately in code. New original artwork, not a copy of any game.
